name: google_maps_geocode
description: Resolve a free-form address or place query into coordinates and a formatted address.

query.description: Address or place query to geocode.

name: google_maps_place_search
description: Search Google Places by text, optionally biased around a latitude and longitude.

max_results.description: Maximum places to return, capped at 10. Default is 5.

name: google_maps_compute_route
description: Compute route data between origin and destination coordinates.

travel_mode.description: Travel mode: DRIVE, WALK, BICYCLE, or TRANSIT. Default is DRIVE.

alternatives.description: Whether to compute alternative routes. Default is false.

language_code.description: BCP-47 language code for localized route text. Default is en.

name: google_maps_route_preview
description: Compute a preview-ready route card payload between origin and destination coordinates.

origin_label.description: Display label for the origin. Default is Origin.

destination_label.description: Display label for the destination. Default is Destination.

travel_mode.description: Travel mode: DRIVE, WALK, BICYCLE, or TRANSIT. Default is DRIVE.

language_code.description: BCP-47 language code for localized route text. Default is en.
